name: Catherine Walker
bio: Catherine Walker is an Irish actress.

credits.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
credits.overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

credits.title: Napoleon
credits.overview: An epic that details the checkered rise and fall of French Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte and his relentless journey to power through the prism of his addictive, volatile relationship with his wife, Josephine.

credits.title: My Sailor, My Love
credits.overview: The thorny relationship between a woman and her retired father worsens after he becomes romantically involved with the housekeeper she hires for him.

credits.title: House of Gucci
credits.overview: When Patrizia Reggiani, an outsider from humble beginnings, marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a reckless spiral of betrayal, decadence, revenge, and ultimately… murder.

credits.title: Rose Plays Julie
credits.overview: A story of a young woman searching for her biological mother. Set against a backdrop of misogyny, revenge, and longing, Rose undertakes a journey that leads her to revelations that are both devastating and dangerous.

credits.title: The Curse of Audrey Earnshaw
credits.overview: A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by a beautiful young woman and the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

credits.title: Cellar Door
credits.overview: A tortured but determined young woman, in the grip of the Catholic Church, searches furiously for the child she believes has been taken away from her, but meets confusion at every corner.

credits.title: We Ourselves
credits.overview: We Ourselves is an unconventional drama about isolation and belonging, about being alone with one’s own thoughts while being part of a shared experience, culture and nation. credits.title: A Dark Song
credits.overview: A determined young woman and a damaged occultist risk their lives and souls to perform a dangerous ritual that will grant them what they want.

credits.title: The Have-Nots
credits.overview: The thin line between happiness and disaster: Jakob cancels a business trip to New York City because he finds out his ex-girlfriend is coming to a party in Berlin on that day: 9/11/2001. His friend Hans goes to the US instead.

credits.title: Patrick's Day
credits.overview: A young man with mental health issues becomes intimate with a suicidal air hostess but his obsessive mother enlists a dysfunctional cop to separate them.

credits.overview: Niamh is the lone survivor of a mysterious massacre in which the furniture and objects in her family’s isolated house took on a monstrous life of their own. credits.overview: Several years after the suicide of a long term girlfriend, David is in a new relationship. However, a chance encounter with the dead woman's sister raises complex questions about just how complicit he was in her death.

credits.title: Ferocious Planet
credits.overview: A groundbreaking device is designed to glimpse alternate universes. But when the machine malfunctions and transports a group of observers into a nightmarish dimension of alien terrors, the travelers must use ingenuity to survive.

credits.overview: A young woman's penchant for sensational Gothic novels leads to misunderstandings in the matters of the heart.

credits.overview: When a priest commits suicide and two trainees are expelled from a seminary, a journalist starts to investigate the Vatican’s silence on broken vows of celibacy. A thriller examining the internal conflicts in the modern Catholic church.
